name: view-in-ar-simple
description: Simple ladder for 'View in your room' AR. Verifies the viewInAr flag is OFF in Simple / ON in Pro, then runs viewInAr on a furnished scene; in the headless (non-iOS) browser it takes the GLB-download fallback and fires the info toast (iOS would instead open AR Quick Look from the USDZ).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-flag-off-in-simple
steps.failMessage: viewInAr should be OFF in Simple mode (pro-tier)

steps.name: verify-flag-on-in-pro
steps.failMessage: viewInAr should be ON in Pro mode

steps.name: verify-ar-toast
steps.failMessage: viewInAr did not fire the AR toast (GLB fallback path)
